install.note: Official installer prepares compatible Node.js. Supports native Windows, macOS and glibc Linux/WSL; musl/Alpine installer unsupported. Honor MCODE_INSTALL_DIR; reopen terminal to update PATH. Desktop is a separate download.

first_run.note: Shares API model settings and EchoBird's saved account list with Desktop. Add an account in EchoBird after explicitly selecting China or international; saving does not automatically switch the client. Applying an account switches the selected installed client. MINIMAX_DATA_DIR (legacy MAVIS_DATA_DIR) overrides the native data directory.
